proven_behavior_and_open_scope: Fixture proves the original promise is retained; separate operational follow-up reporting against both original and revised promises is not implemented.

reference_scenario: Cancelled, lost-contact, incomplete, and already-arrived snapshots
proven_behavior_and_open_scope: Fixtures exercise distinct statuses, retain eligible prediction opportunities without hindsight, and do not recode unknown targets as on time or zero.

reference_scenario: Gate arrival at 14:00 and service start at 15:00
proven_behavior_and_open_scope: Independent fixture changes service/delivery times while the gate-arrival target stays tied to gate arrival; the retained warehouse also checks arrival/service chronology.

reference_scenario: The last valid position is more than 30 minutes old, or no position is available
proven_behavior_and_open_scope: Missing/stale GNSS is explicit; the current 900-second engineering cutoff and feature masking are tested. Adequacy of interval width for these cases is not guaranteed or calibrated.

reference_scenario: Early and late snapshots from the same trip were initially assigned to training and test
proven_behavior_and_open_scope: Whole-tenant/trip grouping, protected roles and exclusive maturity cutoffs are checked. No final-test scoring is implied.
Heldout exclusion and cohort support counts are proven. Heldout-test error, coverage and fallback rates remain unmeasured.

reference_scenario: A nominal 80% interval has only 60% observed coverage
proven_behavior_and_open_scope: A hand-calculated synthetic fixture checks empirical coverage and width (50% in the fixture); M3b.3 reports both for each comparison cohort. The literal 60% scenario and a calibrated final-test interval are not claimed.

reference_scenario: Two trips have substantially different snapshot counts
proven_behavior_and_open_scope: Unequal snapshot counts are exercised for fold metrics and training weights. This does not prove finished snapshot-level and trip-level reporting in every final-test stratum.

reference_scenario: Repeated sends, failed retries, and partial adoption within the same episode
proven_behavior_and_open_scope: The episode, delivery, adoption and action tables have zero rows; no delivery retry/partial-adoption scenario has run.
Quantile intervals are explicit. No delay-probability model, Brier score, probability reliability or calibration-set check has run.

reference_scenario: A repeated hour during daylight-saving transition and a late-arriving arrival correction
proven_behavior_and_open_scope: Separate fixed tests cover repeated local time with different UTC offsets and exclusion of a late-known correction. No claim of a single combined DST/correction integration fixture.

proven_behavior_and_open_scope: The 2026 execution override applies. No optional forecast or public data with unknown historical availability was ingested, so the original dual-clock case has not been executed.
